name: QMill Oy
description: QMill develops AI-powered quantum circuit optimization software to improve the performance and efficiency of quantum algorithms. The company's technology uses machine learning to automatically optimize quantum circuits, reducing gate counts and improving execution fidelity on real quantum hardware. QMill's solutions aim to bridge the gap between theoretical quantum algorithms and practical implementation.

news.title: QMill develops quantum algorithms for the near future on the LUMI supercomputer
news.excerpt: QMill is a Finnish startup company developing quantum algorithms for industrial use on a quantum computer in a 3-5 year timespan. The company uses the LUMI supercomputer to simulate and compare algorithms.

news.title: Blog: QMill's quantum circuits at Junction Quantum Hack 2026
news.excerpt: QMill participated in the pioneering Quantum Hack as both a challenge and tech partner. QMill challenge attracted many participants, who worked on the challenge through the QMill Quantum Advantage Services platform.
